summary: Tail 32 was the first measured intermediate source-policy boundary at 13/15 (86.7%). Three independent 61,440-transition PPO trials then completed all 27 frozen deterministic and stochastic evaluations across seeds 92008, 92096, and 92116 with finite losses and zero worker restarts. This accepts the conditional boss-curriculum rung and authorizes a retained multi-boundary window; it is not normal-start Zone 2 evidence.
